name: Kimi Linear 48B-A3B Instruct
notes: 3:1 KDA linear-attention to MLA: only 7 of 27 layers hold a KV cache, so KV is 7.9 KiB/token (0.96 GiB at 128k, 7.5 GiB at 1M) versus ~3.7 GiB at 128k if every layer were MLA. Paper reports up to 75% KV reduction and 6x decode throughput at 1M. kv_cache_bytes_per_token derived: 7 layers x 576 (kv_lora 512 + rope 64) x 2 bytes.
